subject.title: Feature Request: Extract text from document attachments in Telegram channel

question: What Office-document extraction boundary should OpenClaw support for Telegram and shared attachment context?
rationale: The remaining gap is source-proven, but parsing untrusted Office containers changes dependency, MIME, resource-limit, and prompt-injection boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Bound Shared Extractor Support
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved DOCX/XLSX/PPTX subset through the shared document-extractor/media-understanding path with explicit archive/XML limits and security tests.

options.title: Keep Office External For Now
options.body: Leave core at text/PDF extraction and document a ClawHub, MCP, or plugin path until maintainers approve an in-process Office parser boundary.

options.title: Defer To Provider-Native Design
options.body: Fold the remaining work into the broader provider-native document/file forwarding design instead of adding local Office extraction first.

recommendation.title: Bound Shared Extractor Support
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved DOCX/XLSX/PPTX subset through the shared document-extractor/media-understanding path with explicit archive/XML limits and security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history signal is on the document-extractor and input_file seams this decision would extend.
